integrity: The all-dimensional proof is analytic. Finite enumeration in verify.py checks the moment identity and sample extremizers but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the coordinate characters of \((\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z)^n\) and exponent \(6\); it does not cover general character sets or higher moments.
title: Sharp sixth-moment constant for ternary coordinate characters
